interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and potentially a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) given the road width and speed.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level and repair cracked concrete sections to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures designed for the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Add a furniture or planting zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer.

interventions.title: On-Street Parking Protection
interventions.description: Utilize the existing on-street parking lane with physical barriers or curb extensions to further shield the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the high-speed roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width for protected bike lanes or wider buffers to slow traffic and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Radius Reduction
interventions.description: Tightening the turn radii at the parking lot entrances would slow down turning vehicles and shorten the crossing distance across the driveway.
